verdict.rationale: The product ships as MIT-licensed markdown skill files that, in 'fork' mode, are copied into your repo as ordinary editable files you own outright with no forced updates — a strong openness stance. However, the docs also offer a 'managed bundle' subscribe mode that is explicitly read-only and vendor-controlled, meaning full data ownership/exportability only applies to one of the two install paths, and there's no explicit bulk-export tooling described since the skills already live as files. Missing for 10: an explicit export/migration mechanism, clarity on what happens to the read-only subscribe mode if the vendor disappears, and independent confirmation of easy transferability (community comments call the skills highly personal/non-transferable rather than portable data).
